about: The requests of the link-preview fetchers korbat's share cards are made for (2d design, sections 8.2 and 12.1), as their official pages give them; the card lab and the smoke test send them. robotsToken is the agent's name in infra/caddy/robots.txt, null for a fetcher robots.txt does not name. No request carries a cookie. A note says where a value is not from an official page.

crawlers.name: Slackbot-LinkExpanding
crawlers.note: Slack's page says it fetches as little of a page as it can with Range headers and gives no size: the 32 KiB range is the lab's own.

crawlers.name: LinkedInBot
crawlers.note: No official LinkedIn page gives its fetcher's User-Agent (inputs 3.3, unconfirmed); this string carries the robots.txt token LinkedInBot.

crawlers.name: Mastodon
crawlers.note: The form of mastodon/mastodon's lib/mastodon/version.rb at a8b8d37 for an instance at mastodon.example; its link cards read no robots.txt.
